messages:
maria: Quick heads-up we're locking the marketplace publish plan for CloudStore + EdgeHardware SI. Need final owners for: canonical press release, partner blog, landing redirect, partner badge, SI onboarding runbook, staging smoke tests, and embargo schedule. Short answers please.
sanjay: I'll draft the press release + partner blog. Posting a first cut to #marketing by 11:30 PT. Need design + legal to sign off before I request embargo.
ekaterina: Engineering can handle the CDN redirect and marketplace webhook validation. Drop the partner client_id and redirect URI here and Ill wire it to staging.
jordan: Design will produce the badge and hero variants (desktop + mobile). ETA today end of day. Any CloudStore mandatory brand lockups?
amanda (legal): I will review embargo language and partner quote usage. Please get final press copy to me by 14:00 UTC for same-day review.
mei: SI side: I'll draft the short runbook and the intake flow. I'll also add smoke test scenarios for purchase-to-onboarding.
maria: Sharing the working checklist: https://docs.google.com/document/d/marketplace-gTM-checklist please add your owner tags and blockers.
ekaterina: Suggested CDN rule (301) to preserve query params:
```
# CDN redirect rule
if (path starts_with "/marketplace/cloudstore") {
  return 301 "https://redwood.ai/partners/cloudstore?utm_source=marketplace"
}
```
This keeps analytics intact.
sanjay: Proposed embargo windows: canonical PR time 2025-06-02T15:00:00Z. Partners prefer regional pushes: EMEA 14:00 UTC, US 15:00 UTC, APAC 18:00 UTC. Can we coordinate staggered socials?
amanda (legal): Staggering is OK, but the press release should include a single canonical timestamp in the header. We can note local publish windows in release notes. Also confirm partner quote format (name + title + company).
jordan: Uploading assets to /shared/partnerships/assets now. Files: cloudstore-badge.svg, cloudstore-badge@2x.png. Ill also create a narrow lockup for responsive layouts.
mei: Runbook draft attached to the checklist. Core smoke tests: badge renders, metadata API responds 200, CTA routes to SI intake, analytics event fires \u2014 engineering to signal when staging is ready.
ekaterina: I will run the smoke tests once assets and the redirect are deployed to staging. ETA 90 minutes after deploy; will post pass/fail with logs.
maria: Can we schedule a partner-facing dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT? Need reps from marketing, eng, design, legal, partner ops, and SI.
sanjay: I can host the dry-run and will send a calendar invite once legal confirms embargo copy.
amanda (legal): Confirmed. Ill join and bring the approved quote template and embargo wording.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook template at /runbooks/marketplace-onboard.md. Use the "partner-signed-off" section and attach the handoff ticket number.
mei: Ill run the SI checklist during dry-run and simulate an intake with CloudStore test payload.
maria: Thanks all. Updating owners in the doc now. Please mark items complete or call out blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:
